entities.summary: Frits Vilhelm Holm was a Danish journalist, author and explorer. His books usually gave his name as simply Frits Holm or Frits V. Holm, while US newspapers of the time usually misspelled his name as Fritz von Holm, sometimes claiming that he was a member of the European nobility.
